text: It's a really fun game. You get to make decisions on how the character handles life & choose her fashion. You get to hear some of the conversations they have, which is better than always having to read them. The only thing is if you want to play for longer than 10mins, you have no choice but to purchase diamonds, and they really don't last long for the price you pay. It would be so much better to earn the diamonds/energy in more ways. Sadly, I find myself having to play in very short bursts.😞

Honestly this game is great! no ads, option to skip storyline is nice touch. its a good mix between fun dress up, story line, makeover stuff to merging items which is the funner part for me! I will say when I first played the game It was less expensive to progress in the storyline, makeovers would cost 200ish coins for the entire outfit, makeup and hair but now its like 120 coins to just pick the eyebrows? was much funner to start off with, getting bored of the constant waiting now

it's fantastic really, the story line, the images and mini games keep you entertained for ages in the beginning. I got to around level 35 and just ended up feeling frustrated as it's too hard to progress. You can only play for a few minutes then have to leave it for your energy to build up for about 2-3 hours. energy is hard to buy as you have to buy gems and each energy you buy (100) doubles in price each time. the higher the level, the slower the gameplay. good but frustrating.

Its a good game, but it does seem to take forever to get anything done the energy runs out quick. It takes a while to get the bits you need to merge together and the coins doesn't really get you far. The coins should cover more than they do. Instead of having individual coins for make up it should be all in one go.

ok I have been playing this game for a few months and its definitely growing on me, I just love the variety of outfits to collect and play around with and the daily competition brief ideas are so fun! the storyline is going great, the only thing that annoys me is the increase in charge for gems more energy! 80 to 120 gems for 100 energy has got to change, its really absurd to charge that much! other than that its really fun game!

NO ads!!! it's such a welcome relief to find a game that is ad free! it can take some time to build up coins to play the mini game, but it IS possible - without spending real money. my only criticism is that moves to play the game take a while to build up so you can't spend that much time playing in one go..... but it's add free!!!

It's a great game at first, but as you level up, the items you have to make take so much energy, and as energy takes so much time to recharge, it means there's nothing to do in the meantime. You can't buy energy, you can only buy gems, and the gem costs for energy double each time you buy extra so that rapidly exhausts all of your gems. Such a shame as this game has great potential but i'm rapidly losing interest. It would be great of there was the option to watch ads to earn more energy.

this game is just about perfect. I've played a ton, and in a lot of different styles.. and I really enjoy this one. story, graphics, gameplay - it's fr a gem. the only thing I would criticize is the cost of inventory spaces, it's steep considering the amount of generators/items that take up board space. not even a big deal. seriously great game, really looking forward to seeing it grow

I just started playing the game, but so far it's been fun. I don't usually enjoy merge games, but this one is definitely the exception. The other game aspects (progressing storyline, picking out the fashion, competing with other players for rewards, fulfilling tasks, etc) make a huge difference. I would absolutely recommend this game. I have a lot of stressors in my life ( like most everyone) & this is a great way for me to decompress, have some fun, & escape from the day to day stress of life!

It takes way too long to create just one item for the model to wear. The makeup, hairstyles and colours are far too limited. The accessories are also very limited in choice. The storyline is not needed and quite boring. The merging part is rather stupid in that you don't have a complete board like in a match 3 game. Of course there's in app purchases for totally virtual items that drain our money and make a company wealthier. So, no thanks. Uninstalled.

very addictive, fun, and I love the different styles for each episode. only complaint is that it's frustrating as you progress, running out of energy and waiting for timers so you can get more coins. otherwise, it's a cute game, and i like that you don't *need* to make purchases (I placed #2 in the daily contest my first day playing, no grinding or buying clothes with real money needed) :)

It's just perfect, the graphics are excellent, there are a lot of occasions or themes to dress up for so you won't get bored easily and the best part is that there are no ads😲 but just like other games you still need to buy or pay for certain things in order to fully experience the perks the game has to offer. Overall it is one of the best fashion games I've ever come across.😁

have been playing a few weeks now and loved it at first still love the story line however in just a few short weeks the cost of everything is getting ridiculous if it continues to be this way I will unfortunately have to delete this game and play something else. I understand the need for money that is why if I feel a game is not trying to force me to spend money just to advance to the next level I don't mind spending money on the packages and events and stuff. UPDATE JUST DELETED GAME

This is one of the only games on my phone that I haven't deleted and that I play nearly every day. There are no ads, but you do run out of energy and are unable to play unless you spend gems (which cost $). However, gems can also be earned playing a lot. I haven't paid a single dollar and have still spent hundreds of gems. The story is interesting, the amount of clothes options are amazing, and overall the game is really fun. I highly recommend it!

At first I loved this game. But the farther you get in, the more frustrating it becomes. I have bought gems and energy and special passes, spending way more money than I want to just trying to complete challenges and despite that always fall short. The worst part is the part of the game I was there for was the dress up part. As the game goes on it is harder to earn coins, and you spend a majority of the coins you do earn on the storyline, that I personally find annoying. I'm tapping out.

i love this game but it's honestly deserve only 2 or 1 star. why? because while the chapter is leveling up, the money you need also need to increase in order to complete a whole look/ chapter. and it doesn't make sense because the energy is still the same amount as before. it takes too long get more energy— leading to very slow progress of the game. also, i really hate how it needs to be updated time to time, like TIME TO TIME. it's only fun to play when you have money for the game.://

I really enjoyed this game, but I'm uninstalling it because its design feels manipulative. Coin costs keep increasing while energy stays limited, and you're often forced to spend resources on things that don't advance the story. The game frequently creates situations where you're out of energy and tempted to pay for progress. These "opportunities" seem to appear only when you're stuck. I also never win OOTD, which often feels like it's filled with bots rather than real players. Ispent much money

Fun game. It's better than other merge games, but it's still a merge game. The worst part is how long it takes to get items, and how little energy you get. Example, you need shoes, you press the wardrobe 50 times and only get 1 pair of shoes and 49 clothing items. Now you're out of energy, and you haven't fulfilled an order. This is why these games lose me. I'd give it 3 1/2 stars if possible, for that alone.

I'm addicted to this game! The storyline is really good, and I always want to know what's going to happen next. In the beginning, merges are easier and take up less energy. But as you get further along, the energy cost for each item is outrageous! I'll work on the same item for 2 whole days or more sometimes! The side games are fun, and the outfit of the day is something I look forward to each day. But if you don't pay to play, you're going to get frustrated pretty fast as you move ahead.

I spent some money on this game thinking I could at least finish an event, but no. This game just wants money, and it feels like my time and money were wasted. It’s very frustrating. I even spent a lot of time checking the game every few hours just hoping to complete the event, but it still wasn’t enough. Overall, the game is disappointing and not worth the time, money, or effort.

The game is STINGY. I don't mind paying something here and there, but you just give so little energy, too few rubies, too expensive outfits, the player keeps on paying, yet still has very limited resources. Besides being expensive, it's also very time consuming, you keep on making every product from zero and the shop has limited types of products, so you can't do anything to move faster. Compared to other similar games out there, it's really not worth the time and the money.

Has anyone else started having issues after the update? I'm so frustrated because I enjoy this game and have put plenty of others on to it. Since the update, the OOTD Challenge has been glitchy. I'm getting error messages sometimes preventing me from entering the challenge and sometimes after I've already entered the challenge. I've reached out to customer service about 5x and they keep excusing my concerns and I'm feeling dismissed. Love the game, but this is disappointing.

It's not exactly a pay to win game but it's definitely 'pay to progress faster' haha a good way to enforce responsible purchases as well as making sure players also don't spend too much time on this game. What I'm trying to say is, it's genuinely a fun game, quite the relaxed pace and very nice storytelling. The animated poses/emotes are a bit exaggerated but I can get past it. Thank you for such a nice game so far. Wish there were more ways to get the energy but so far so good!

One of the best fashion merge games to come along and I enjoy playing it a lot. But, you get to a certain level and things start to stagnate a little bit. Higher tier combos needed when your generator (lemon tree, really?) doesn't have enough charge to finish, so it takes days. I tend to focus on the Glow and Go tasks first, so waiting on those generators can sometimes backfire. But, yeah I'm here, still playing, still having fun. Mostly.

not into merge games but this one is really fun, there's a lot of mini games and other stuff to do as well. it quickly became a Daily thing for me. if there's one downside, it's the fact that you can run out of things to do (energy) in wich you have to either pay or wait hours to play for 20 minutes. Just speaks to how addicting this game is. I wish you could watch ads or something for emery to allow more play time. Great game none the less!

I want to give this game 5 stars but there is no way to earn energy except waiting or spending a ton of money, even sometimes no way to spend money on it. The price of packages is way too expensive for what you get and even though the game itself is really fun and well-designed with a good story, I am getting frustrated not being able to play when I want to. There really should be the option to watch ads to earn energy, and you should earn energy back with completing orders or storyline quests.

You run out of energy too quickly. There is too much merging, and not enough dress-up, not enough story. You are forced to merge the same items over and over and over and over. I almost reached level 31, but even the outfit of the day and the outfit for the girl that you name became a chore. It's not fun when you can't pick your own outfit or choose your own colors. The entire game is too limiting, and expensive if you want to reach higher levels. I'm very disappointed and frustrated playing.

this is a fun game, i dont mind paying for extra credits. it would be a great 5 star game except less than 25% of what you play for actually goes towards the goals. 75% is charged to hear the storyline, no other game takes all your points that way. and there's no way around it. seems to get worse the more I spend and the higher the level.

This is a really solid merge game, with a fun fashion component and interesting stories. There is a daily style contest that lets you play around with lots of clothing options. The graphics are high quality and you can play without spending money. There is limited energy, which is usually the thing I am most tempted to spend on because I'm having so much fun! I would love a "free dress" option to be added in the future.

I definitely love the game..I've spent way too much money though. it seems like 100 energy only lasts 5 minutes . then I have to wait forever for it to refill I also think it's unfair to have to spend coins to have conversations. I get excited that I've collected enough coins to add another piece of clothing,jewelry or makeup just to have to skip during boring character. conversation. it should be free or take only a small amount of coins. other than that the clothing designs are amazing 🤩

Good base game with cute graphics. All challenges in and outside the main merge game cant be completed unless you are in the game all the time or pay. OOTD challenges i always seem to be in the same point range for scoring which isnt statistically probable unless there are groups of people voting for eachother, which sucks, or its AI design. Styling outfits takes such a long time as it takes ages to gain enough coins.

The game is tempting why, because it has story plots. You will be curious what happen next, and they kept bringing new issues, ex, debt, agency etc. I don't like the task like extra event bonus where u have to merge to certain points, I purchased few packs but still not win to the end. and I guess this is algorithm not to win, but for users to purchase more. overall, it wasting yr time and money.

I love this game. the story part of it is really interesting. it keeps you intrigued. I have noticed that the amount of coins you need to play the interactive portion increases & so does the amounts for the merges as the game progresses & you only get 100 moves every 2/3 hours unless you make purchases the storyline and merging moves very slowly 🐌 I also keep getting a "somethings wrong" message when I open the app every few times even though its updated. I have to close and open it again.

I'm only on level 14 and I spend more time trying to get coins to design an outfit piece by piece than I do designing outfits. There's never enough energy to do enough orders to get the coins unless I play multiple times a day every day, or pay real money. I'm frustrated and disappointed instead of having fun at this point.

I enjoyed this game at first. Now at level 35 I don't. The energy levels take ages to restore and I've started playing other merge games. I realise that other games give you energy as you complete orders so you can spend more time playing. With this game you either purchase energy or have to wait. As your level increases you need more coins to finish a level. 250 coins approximately for choosing a lipstick for the model. But you can't even finish 1 order for 100 coins with 100 energy.

I have spent money on the game, so the game manufacturer can't complain I didn't spend any money. The OOTD challenge is the biggest sham, player has to spend rubies in order to be in the voting loop, it's never about skills, which defeats the whole purpose of being in the competition. It's like winning a football game because the club paid the referees and not because the players can score. update: what's the point of providing my game ID? Are you going to change the rules of the OOTD challenge?

Played it for a few months. Was great at first, but eventually lost my interest. The events/minigames get harder to clear, i always get ranked 100+ on the daily dressing contest despite trying my best (the people who did rank 1-40 sometimes isn't even the appropriate outfit for the theme), when you dress up your avatar in profile you can't change the background or scenario into something else - only the current background of the story's episode you're in. IMO, not much fashion items look good.

I love this game I've been playing for about 2 weeks now. I just wish that it was easier to get energy. It takes so long to "recharge" and like 3 min to use it all up yes the further along you get by collecting stickers you get your rewards and it's not too bad but it takes a while. So if you don't have much patience "waiting for your energy to recharge" and you don't like to spend money in games then this might not be for you, but overall not a bad game.

I'm knocking my rating down. I'm so frustrated with the daily challenge. about a week and a half ago I started consistently placing 101 with 189 votes everyday for 5 days and then about ann hour or 2 before voting would end I'd place 98. Notified of bug. It still will be an issue for at least several hours everyday and typically doesn't work until I complain. Today I was getting tons of votes and doing great and all of a sudden it put me at 101 again. They don't fix bug.

This is my all-time favorite merge game ever. It has great outfits to put together with daily challenges with Lots of opportunity to increase wardrobe and has an interesting story line. Overall, a decent amount of rewards and energy although I'd love more to play longer. The only Down side is fighting my impulse to spend tons of money because I enjoy it so much. Without spending a lot of money it is fun. of note I do pay for monthly mission reward bonuses.

Updating my review after I stopped spending $ & realized THIS GAME IS NOTHING BUT A MANIPULATIVE MONEY GRAB!! I’ve spent over $200 but always end up in the same place: out of energy, waiting, or paying again! Energy caps at 100, but higher orders need far more, so you’re stuck. Prices are ridiculous—270 rubies for one item, 560 for another, and energy costs keep increasing! You also need tons of coins just to finish one outfit. It’s designed to make you think spending helps, but it never does!!

I was enjoying this game but over time the mini extra games the journeys that last a week are getting harder and harder to finish and buying the VIP packs and all the extras and still couldn't get the last prize 3 times .. spent hundreds on this app and will be deleting it at the end of the month. this is bad business and you are ripping customers and players off..

I would normally have given this 5 stats, as I've been playing the game a while I enjoy it. I even buy packs and such. However, I bought the vip/super pass to the deserts one on Saturday, however for some reason this time, I didn't get access to the previous levels gifts, so I raised a ticket then I pinged it again and again for 4 days. Still no response. So I've spent a few quid on something I don't get fully and no response.

this game GOES! I'm obsessed. love the merging to earn coins and spend coins on fashion. I love that you can redeem points for stuff for your closet. it has a lot of features that other games have, but for some reason the combination of all those different features really does it for me. I'm sad when I run out of energy.

I am loving this game so far! This is exactly what I was looking for in a fashion game. There SHOULD be a story to go with the clothes--and there is one here! That's so refreshing in contrast to the mindless styling games that depend on the votes of others. I can't wait to see how the narrative progresses as I level up! Animation is LOVELY!

I really enjoy this game love the story line. I do not like how this game takes your Money when the are doing their skits abdvalso half your money is gone and one eyebrow was done On the card game where your suppose to be rewarded for all those cards when you reach 135 well on my first one I never got my rewards im highly disappointed. I probably will stop playing the game.

The game is overall very fun and satisfying, but I just hope the rechargeable energy can be increased to 200 instead of just 100, because it's easily drained out and we need to wait for a few hours until it's full again. Other than that everything else is fine and I enjoy it.

The biggest money-grubber playing app ever...been spending more than hundred of dollars just to get the gems and energy, and the 5 star stickers pack.....left with 1 more sticker to go for the complete reward set...but all the 5 star stickers are duplicates! So your main intention here is to empty our wallets for your own personal gain is it??! Why can't u be fair to us players? Newbies, please delete the game!

super fun merge game with no ads. the mini games and events are fun as well. i like being able to design outfits and there are lots of choices for clothes, hair, makeup, accessories, etc. you don't need to spend real money to do well in this game.

I am impressed with this game. No ads, and still enjoyable if you don't make purchases. It does get more challenging for the story to progress if you don't buy but you just need to be more patient as your energy increases. I actually didn't mind paying a little because I am loving the game a lot.

I wanted to like it and I expected it to be even metter than hollywood crush but the makeover part just does not compare at all to hollywood crush. it's very simple, you don't get to design anything and most of the looks are just copies from the original game. I'm very disappointed. I would also like to echo what others have said. I continued to play because I enjoy merging but by level 30 I can barelly play that. I need lemons for all the tasks and I barely get any lemons daily.

I like playing this game but it doesn't give you much opportunity to win energy or anything like most of these other merge games. looks like they could improve that. after all, what good is the game if you can't play it? even though I am disappointed with the lack of energy options, I love playing this game. it makes me feel like I'm playing barbies with a bunch of friends. I loved Barbies when I was a kid and this game makes me think of that.

started off really enjoying this game but found out weeks later its a huge money trap. says you earn xp and the majority of time you waste money on pointless conversations with no reward. plus further you go the more you spend as it gets harder. took the joy out so now deleting the app. the makers are money grabbers. ive wasted around 30 quid like an idiot to barely complete orders as the more you spend the more you need. its addictive and thats how the makers earn. dont waste your money.

In my opinion, this is the best fashion/merge game out there! The storyline, the merge game, the fashion comps, and other mini games...please don't change this game (unless it is to make it better). I actually look forward to playing it, it's so fun!
fun game, i keep coming back it. silly plot, unrealistic and I hate drama, but... only issue is there is TOO much going on, so many mini games and contests, and stuff, I can't keep it all straight.

After reading a lot of the comments on this game. I thought I would give it a try. First thing I would agree energy should be increased to 200 instead of 100.... With that said this game is fun and addicting wanting to know what happens next. Second I would agree Rose should be able to change clothes depending on what's going on.

I really love this game and enjoy the storyline and gameplay. Unfortunately, the game keeps crashing whenever I log in. Before I can do anything, the app closes and displays an error related to Google Play Services. I have already tried reinstalling the game and checking that Google Play Services is enabled, but the issue still persists. Please fix this problem, as it is preventing me from enjoying the game. Thank you.

Game double takes your points. You'll warn points and then it'll repeat the same event and take the points again. Unfortunately it takes forever to earn coins so it's constantly wanting you to buy more. I reported this to their systems team as a big bit they said nope no bug!!!! They're taking our money to make you repeat everything. SCAM!! I did like it initially but they scam you after you start liking the game and customer service won't help!

Excellent game, graphics and storyline! NO ADS! The fashion and design options are awesome! The earning rate is great and allows you to win items to use and energy to keep playing. However, the main character has a step sister that is disgustingly rude to her. I understand every story has an antagonist, but it is disappointing and strange that there are never options for the protagonist to defend herself. I really like this game and enjoyed playing and would have given 5 stars until I reach my next level. the orders take far to much energy to fill. I've had to come back and play 10 minutes (give or take 3 minutes) at a time and have not been able to fill enough orders to do anything. you either need to increase the energy players get or make the orders easier to fill. I'm ready to uninstall the game, it isn't any fun to play now. I've been trying to put a belt on for 2 days no fun
love the game and the story progression. would love if the amount of coins earned was higher, OR if it cost less coins to progress. it is a good game because you don't need to spend real money.

I really enjoy this game. It's aesthetically pleasing, fun dialogue, and relaxing. I will say if you do spend some money it is easier to progress quicker. But overall, if you love fashion, this game is for you! 🩷

I was really enjoying this game until I made an in game purchase and did not get the reward in its entirety. When I messaged support they just replied that I did get it and stopped responding. I am confident I did not get the entire reward because I made the purchase to have more energy to play and still did not have energy after the purchase.

I would really like it if they would with the dancing when you hit for the energy it always gives you 25 energy and it's always 25 energy it's not random I would really like it if it was a different amount every time what happens if you buy it and you get small energy like 25 each time I get it they want you to pay for it but I'm just fed up with it because it's not fair and it's not going to be 25 ins you pay for it please fix this where you can at least get 100 energy very dissatisfied
I would love to give it 5 🌟, but you have to spend so much money to get anywhere in the game. Also, when you participate in all the "Events", the prizes suck......1 coin for it!!! 😞

DO NOT get this game, they have banned my account because I requested a refund as a I thought the package wasn't enough for the price so they gave me a 24 hour notice to pay or get banned which is insane. I've payed money to this game and had really good experience with customer service until now. Message 9 times and had no reply. Will be keeping it at 1 star review until this is resolved. I've spent loads and now can't even play it. Disgusting.
It's annoying that to continue the story you have to do a ton of merging that takes up energy that you have to either have enough gems for it buy it. But other than that it's fun and cute.

been playing since January, only way to win anything or be able to play longer than 5 mins a day is if you purchase things. I tested it without paying, and then again with paying. only good if you spend money. Will never get anywhere on daily dress up challenge without paying, somehow gets "more votes" when paid for 🙄 and is the same challenge every other day, would be nice if they were a little more creative but you will either be doing "vintage vibe" or "dog walks" every single day.
finally a game is free to play with options of purchase. I didn't spend and still able to enjoy the game. Also, no ads! It's a good game with story and the side games.
Love this game so far! However, would like to suggest to have more energy than the 100 that is given, especially for those who are playing for free. I love the aesthetics and the storyline too.

I generally liked the game very much, however since a while it always kicks me back exactly to rank 101 in the daily OOTD challenge. Very annoying! Edit: now downgrading rating to 1 star, as bug is still not fixed.

Just started playing but really enjoying it! A really nice mix of merge, design and pick your path story (I loved those books as a kid!) Overall layout is nice. Offers are reasonably priced. you dont have to spend to succeed either which is something many games dont get, when you dont HAVE to buy you are more likely to want to buy.

I love this game but the prices are high and to get lives you got to pay 160 rubies for 100 lives and then you keep getting the same cards when you spend so many rubies to complete a mission. I don't think thats fair. if a person love the game they gone spend the money so why be we expensive when I downloaded it said no money, no ads and etc the no ads yes but I've spent all ready in the hundreds. False advertisement.

I'm pleasantly surprised. While a merge game, there's an incredibly intriguing storyline that is fantastic to follow along with! The art style is pretty similar to Time Princess, there are even a few identical pieces. Major selling point, no intrusive ads! My only issues are the use of AI voices and that stamina is pretty limited with no ability to choose to watch ads or something to replenish without spending IRL funds

How can I play this game when I don't get options for more lives and either it became expensive already wasted alot of my money on that. This game is so addicted once you start playing you will play the whole day and even not hesitate to spend dollars on it and afterwards when you see your account you will be shocked.

I have been playing this for a while and having fun. Then I bought some packs and was double charged for every single one. I went back and forth for DAYS and they still won't accept any proof I provide. Deleting the app and really angry that's how you would treat people.

The game is definitely engaging, and you don't Have to spend real money to advance but it's a little slow going after the first few levels if you don't because you don't gain energy and coins fast enough. Other than that, I am enjoying it so far.

I love the variety in merge items and the rewards for completing each order seem balanced. Getting gems and energy isn't too big of a chore either, though I definitely wish there was a higher energy cap so I could play longer! Oh and no ads is always a bonus! Love this game!

This game is so addictive but I'm dissapointed. I completed an event where I was supposed to be rewarded with lighting bolts and didn't receive them. I wasted lightning, gems and time for nothing. What was the point? Also, unless you pay, the mini games become impossible to complete after a while.

Love the game, would be nice to be able to remove pieces though. Having to wear something from every single clothing category, really can some of the outfits ugly 😭 Besides that, it's a good storyline, with interesting characters.

the energy runs out quickly, and there is no way to refill it except by using red gems. Also, there are no promotional videos available to help refill the energy when watching them. Energy must be refilled after every chapter

I've been on this game for a while now, and the game is quite fun. However, I noticed that the daily rewards are not being added on the game board. Also, the tasks assigned are quite big compared to the small amount being paid. Please look into it.

It is a good game, but I tried Hollywood Crush to see how different they were. Crush has so much more gameplay and more fun in my opinion. But match 3 is too tough for me, so I'm sticking with this one. I would love to see more of the gameplay of Crush in this one too. Merge is easy, but takes so much time. I'm at episode 16 and it always takes more and more coins. Like the dress and the color choice are 2 different tasks. Can you make early episodes easier as you add more?

i actually enjoy playing this. no ads, no required in-game purchases, and no bugs. the game contains stories, unique and cute clothing and accessories, frequent level rewards, and different ways to get energy and gems. a glow up would be to improve energy gaining. you only get up to 15 energy from voting and i believe that its better that way because it makes you want to come back later to play but the game is quite addicting. i recommend if youre looking for something to play while bored.

I'm editing this review, because they actually seem to listen and care and stuff. Original: 2 stars. The game is fun, the story is cute and drew me in. I've even spent money on this to keep playing. It is a bit pushy with the "buy this pack, buy that deal!" pop-ups. But there's a lot of things to do. Merging, the story, collecting things, dress up. It keeps you busy when you run out of energy. Thankfully the one issue I had was one day only. "Tagged only" clothes for daily dress up sucks.

This game is engaging...in the beginning. As you progress, every makeover task requires coins. Whereas in the beginning, a lot of it was more of a bundle (makeup, jewelry, accessories). You even need coins to just advance to the next task without even being able to add to the makeover. The orders to get coins grow repetitive and frustrating. And the styles get boring (turtle necks, shorts) as you advanced but takes hundreds of coins per item just to complete.
